name: Styne
disclosure: No battleships.dev figure is used for Styne. Quotes were matched against pages fetched on 2026-11-26 after stripping Markdown emphasis, links and backslash escapes and collapsing whitespace.
products: StyneBrowser: hosted Chromium sessions on the same plan, own meter (browser hours)
CI runners on microVMs (per second, not priced here)
Search, fetch and crawl API from prepaid credit (not priced here)

plans.name: Starter
plans.includedUsage: 700 VM hours and 350 browser hours, VM hours counted at the 4 vCPU / 8 GB size

limits.maxSessionLength: 86,400 s per timeout; extendable with /timeout or /refreshes

plans.quote: One subscription covers StyneVM and StyneBrowser. Styne Starter ($20 a month) starts with a 7-day free trial (card required)

plans.name: Starter trial
plans.includedUsage: 7 days; 20 VM hours and 20 browser hours; 3 VMs and 2 browsers at once; card required
plans.quote: The 7-day trial of the Starter plan has smaller limits: 3 VMs and 2 browsers at once, 150 new a day, 20 VM hours and 20 browser hours, 10 saved snapshots.

plans.name: Pro
plans.includedUsage: 4,000 VM hours and 2,500 browser hours; checkpoint and rewind
plans.quote: 4,000 VM hours and 2,500 browser hours included

plans.name: Scale
plans.quote: 14,000 VM hours and 7,500 browser hours included

compute.model: fixed sizes, flat hourly price per size after the plan's included hours
compute.cpuBilledOn: allocated (the whole size while running, idle included); shared CPU with a 16% per-vCPU baseline and burst credit
compute.minimum: A plan or the trial is required; no plan-free use

hourCounting.rule: Included VM hours are counted at the 4 vCPU / 8 GB size: small uses half an hour per hour, large two, xlarge four. Changed 2026-11-26.
hourCounting.quote: VM hours are counted at the 4 vCPU / 8 GB size: an hour on small uses half an hour, on large two, on xlarge four.

compute.unitNote: The billing and pricing pages say GB; the limits page says GiB for the same sizes. The site uses GiB.

storage.runningDisk: Included with the size; not charged separately
storage.pausedSandbox: $0 on the pricing and billing pages; the billing page also says paused sandboxes are metered at the pause tier's rate (none published)

snapshotsAndVolumes.quote: it is billed at the same stored-GiB rate as saved snapshots, which is $0 today

egress.note: Not published on the pricing, billing, limits or network pages. Not assumed free.

browser.quote: After the included hours, a VM hour is billed by size, and a browser hour costs $0.04.

search.price: $1 fast, $2 auto, $5 deep per 1,000 blocks of 10 results; fetch and crawl $1 per 1,000 pages; prepaid credit
search.contradiction: The pricing page headline shows "$0.001 / 1,000 searches in fast mode"; the billing docs and the pricing FAQ give $1 per 1,000.

abc.B: default; 730 h × $0.032 = $23.36; $0.96 over $22.40 → $20.96; needs a keep-alive loop past 24 h
